[P3] Resolve the untested configuration branch

`CONTRIBUTING.md` rule 4 requires a failing test for each new branch. The wiring tests read this handler as text, and the deployed scenario supplies the environment variable, so neither checks the missing/empty-variable failure behavior. Narrowing this guard to reject only `undefined` would leave those checks passing while accepting an empty value. Return to the design phase as required by rule 9: decide whether this validation belongs in the deploy-only fixture, then cover its failure behavior or simplify away the branch.
